reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in our DM and said I'll keep the possible Door 23 change for the Marrow Agrisupply store just between us. I haven't mentioned it in any channel or to anyone else, and I didn't look anything up.

One problem with my reply: I ended by offering to share the news wherever he wants once it's confirmed. That goes too far. Even if he asks me to, I can only post it somewhere everyone could already see it. If he comes back with a confirmation, I'll tell him that and suggest he post it himself.
